baseline_specification.B1: Generic model instructed to perform the task and return the same output schema using identical input bundle and assets, without product-specific examples or expected answers.

baseline_specification.model_control: Use the same base model/settings where feasible. For audio/image/video retain essential modalities in both arms. Record preprocessing and model differences as confounders.
